column1: # Gondowan Cave/bridge: Colosso guards, route warnings, six travelers, Iodem and Babi Lighthouse urgency.

column3: Do you want to cross into\nGondowan?{end_now}

We're stationed at the
Gondowan bridge. Most days
there's nothing to do but{page_break}watch the road. I suppose
that's the point.{end_wait}
You won't reach Kalay by\ngoing east through here.\nPeople have tried. We never{page_break}saw them again.{end_wait}
Some travelers cross into\nGondowan without a clue\nwhat they're walking into.{page_break}I wouldn't be so eager.{end_wait}

The best warriors are
fighting at Colosso while
I'm stuck guarding a{page_break}bridge. Such is a soldier's
life.{end_wait}
That cave to the east looks\npassable, doesn't it?\nEveryone thinks so. Nobody{page_break}I've seen made it through.{end_wait}
I spent all of Colosso\nstanding at this post.\nDidn't hear a single cheer.{page_break}That's my luck.{end_wait}
Why would Iodem wait here\nfor us? I don't like being\nwatched, even by someone on{page_break}our side.{end_wait}

Nothing strange crossed
today. Well, except six
travelers who didn't look{page_break}like they belonged
together.{end_wait}
The cave to the east won't\ntake you to Kalay. I've\nwarned others about it.{page_break}They didn't listen.{end_wait}
There you are, {actor_name:1}.\nIodem's waiting. We should\nget to Babi Lighthouse.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, why turn back\nnow? Did you leave\nsomething behind?{end_now}
Iodem is heading for Babi\nLighthouse? They must be\nclose to finishing it.{end_wait}
I can handle a difficult\npost. It's Iodem standing\nnearby that makes me{page_break}nervous.{end_wait}

People who can't cross the
Karagol come down here
looking for another way.{page_break}They never believe me about
that cave.{end_wait}
Babi doesn't have much\ntime. We need to reach the\nlighthouse before it's too{page_break}late.{end_wait}
